mapper.sql: code, engine_key, name, steps, diagram_layout, revision, published_version, published_revision, enabled
mapper.select: select from wf_template where business = #{business} order by code
select from wf_template where business = #{business} and code = #{code} for update
mapper.insert: insert into wf_template (business, code, engine_key, name, steps, diagram_layout, revision, edited_by) values (#{business}, #{code}, #{engineKey}, #{name}, #{steps}, #{diagramLayout,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, #{editedBy})
mapper.update: update wf_template set name = #{name}, steps = #{steps}, diagram_layout = #{diagramLayout,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, revision = revision + 1, edited_by = #{editedBy}, edited_at = current_timestamp where business = #{business} and code = #{code} and revision = #{revision}
mapper.insert: insert into wf_template_release (business, code, version, name, steps, diagram_layout, definition_id, published_by) values (#{business}, #{code}, #{version}, #{name}, #{steps}, #{diagramLayout,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{definitionId}, #{publishedBy})
mapper.sql: select r.code, r.name, r.version, r.definition_id, r.steps, r.diagram_layout from wf_template t join wf_template_release r on t.business = r.business and t.code = r.code and t.published_version = r.version where t.business = #{business} and t.enabled = true
mapper.select: select version, name, cast(published_by as varchar) as published_by, published_at from wf_template_release where business = #{business} and code = #{code} order by version desc
mapper.update: update wf_template set enabled = #{enabled}, published_revision = case when published_revision = revision then revision + 1 else published_revision end, revision = revision + 1, edited_by = #{editedBy}, edited_at = current_timestamp where business = #{business} and code = #{code} and revision = #{revision}
